dedupe_keys.name: utc and localtime dataset for half hourly settlement periods for united kingdom s electrical balancing and settlement

description: This Zenodo deposit supplies a machine-readable mapping between Great Britain electricity settlement dates and half-hour periods, UTC and local time. The public version 2.0.0 CSV is about 54 MB and the repository states CC BY 4.0. The provider says the current mapping uses ISO 8601, replacing an earlier RFC 3339-labelled release. Electricity demand, generation and balancing datasets often index rows by settlement period, not an unambiguous clock time. This table could align those inputs across daylight-saving changes before an electricity-system simulation or historic dispatch check. It is a calendar conversion resource, not a measured demand series or an operational balancing service. The public page does not document every column, covered date span or how exceptional settlement days are encoded. Those details and the mapping itself need file-level inspection before production use. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this particular settlement-time lookup. The CSV was not downloaded.
name: UTC and localtime dataset for half-hourly settlement periods for United Kingdom's electrical balancing and settlement
